prompt: What is the difference between Top-Down Memoization and Bottom-Up Tabulation in Dynamic Programming?
options: Top-Down uses recursion with caching; Bottom-Up iteratively fills a table in topological dependency order
Top-Down uses less time complexity than Bottom-Up
explanation: Top-Down executes recursively on demand and saves computed subproblems in a cache. Bottom-Up starts from base cases and fills an array/table iteratively without recursion overhead.
